1.text: To think, SQUARE... you stand there attempting to challenge your future self. How amusing.

2.text: And yet, it seems you and your puny friend have made it all the way to the end.
2.name: Magus Domini

3.text: I am no god, perhaps... but look at how pathetic your shapes are compared to mine.
3.name: Magus Domini

4.text: Your two-dimensional forms were simply made to be crushed.
4.name: Magus Domini

5.text: Do not take revenge, my dear friends, but leave room for my fury.
5.name: Magus Domini

6.text: Fear not, for I am your forthcoming being; I will uphold you with my righteous right hand.
6.name: Magus Domini
